Dear {vendor} team,

We are writing to give formal notice of non-renewal for {agreement}. Brightwater Coffee Co. does not wish this agreement to renew when the current term ends on {term_end}.

The agreement states: "{notice_clause}". We are providing this notice within that period, before the {deadline} deadline.

Please confirm in writing that you have received this notice of non-renewal and that the agreement will not renew. Please also let us know if you need anything further from us to process it.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,
{sender}
